title: Anthropic Seeks Google's Backing For Data Center Leases Before Wall Street Debut
source_used: Yellow.com text, which says 'Reuters reported Thursday'. Reuters not found in Google News (5-day search) and blocked here if found.
key_facts: Anthropic has signed more than a dozen preliminary agreements to lease US data centres with combined capacity above 1 gigawatt (Reuters, as relayed by Yellow).
Company executives discussed an arrangement in which Google would stand behind the lease payments if Anthropic could not meet them.
Neither Google nor Anthropic addressed the specifics; Google declined to comment on rumours or speculation.
Yellow (not attributed to Reuters) says Apollo and Blackstone would supply private credit through a special-purpose vehicle, after a $35 billion private credit package closed last week.
Yellow (not attributed to Reuters) says Google has committed up to $40 billion to Anthropic and co-designs some of its chips.
quote_evidence: Anthropic has signed more than a dozen preliminary agreements to lease US data centers with combined capacity above 1 gigawatt, Reuters reported Thursday.
Company executives have also discussed an arrangement in which Google would stand behind those lease payments if Anthropic could not meet them.
Neither Google nor Anthropic addressed the specifics, with Google declining to comment on rumors or speculation.
why_it_matters_hint: Anthropic's build-out leans on rivals for financing; the Google guarantee is unconfirmed.
